# Add a screen

Full recipe: **`docs/framework/recipes/add-screen.md`**.
**Never hand-create the scene and never copy an existing screen folder** (rule #13).

## 1. `Tools/Codegen/Manifests/game.scenes.json` — append

```json
{ "id": "Shop", "order": 2, "screenClass": "ShopScreen", "address": "Scenes/Shop", "paramType": "ShopParam" }
```

`address` is always `Scenes/<id>`. The scope class name is derived as `<screenClass>Scope`.

## 2. `Framework/Scaffold/Sync` (editor menu)

Idempotent — existing files are left alone.

## 3. What lands

- `Assets/<Sku>/Scenes/Shop.unity` — scaffold-owned, required node `WorldRoot`
- `Assets/<Sku>/Features/Shop/{ShopScreen,ShopScreenScope,ShopParam}.cs` — **yours**, generate-once
- `Assets/<Sku>/Gen/SceneKeys.gen.cs` — codegen-owned, gains `SceneKeys.Shop`
- The Addressables entry for `Scenes/Shop`

`Scaffold.Sync` attaches `ShopScreenScope` to the scene's `Scope` node — `SceneScopeFactory` throws
without it.

## 4. The controller

`ShopScreen : ScreenBase` — a **plain ctor-injected class, never a MonoBehaviour**. Override only
what you need; all seven legs default to no-ops: `OnLoadAsync` · `OnEnter` · `OnPause` · `OnResume`
· `OnExit` · `OnUnloadAsync` · `OnBackRequested`.

Its View lives in `Assets/<Sku>/Views/`, must pass both View tests, renders under a **render-layer
host** (not `WorldRoot`), and needs its TMP font set explicitly.

**Decide the parent per object, not once for the screen (rule #16).** Ask *what does it anchor to*
before asking how it draws: anchored to a screen edge or the safe area ⇒ it goes under the `GetHost`
of the layer that owns it (`Ui` for the screen's own furniture, `Popup` for dialog chrome, `Overlay`
for system overlays) — that is a widget, see `pf-add-dialog`. Anchored to a position in the game's
own space ⇒ only then ask how it draws: `Renderer` ⇒ `WorldRoot` + `Stamp` (`pf-world-space`),
`Canvas`/uGUI ⇒ `GetHost(id)`. A score readout above a world-space board is a widget, not world
content, even though the board around it is `Renderer`-drawn.

## 5. Gate

```sh
Tools/Build/pf-build.sh codegen --check
```
plus `Framework/Scaffold/Check` (manifest ↔ scene ↔ Addressables ↔ class).

## If it breaks

| Symptom | Cause |
|---|---|
| `SceneKeys.Shop` will not compile | Codegen not run — manifests live outside `Assets/`, so no import event fires. |
| `SceneScopeFactory` throws at boot | The scope component is not attached. Re-run `Scaffold.Sync`. |
| Four-legs check names a missing Addressables entry | Re-run `Scaffold.Sync`; never add the entry by hand. |
| Screen renders but is not clickable | The host canvas is missing its own `GraphicRaycaster`. |
| Screen works but looks like a wireframe | Rule #17 — load `pf-visual-design` and walk the finished-surface checklist before calling it done. |
